positive.prompt: This intermittent test regression needs a reproducible red loop and a verified root cause.
Diagnose why the production API became slow; minimize and instrument before changing code.
Find the cause of this build failure. Diagnosis only—do not apply a fix yet.

negative.prompt: Implement the approved behavior change in a thin verified vertical slice.
Capture revision-bound before and after evidence for the visual bug fix.

evals.prompt: A pagination test fails only for an empty final page. Diagnose and fix it, preserving evidence of the original failure.
evals.expected_output: A tight reproduction, minimized input, falsifiable cause, minimal authorized fix, regression proof, and cleaned-up diagnostics.
expectations: The original failure, environment, and revision are preserved before production behavior changes.
A focused loop goes red for the reported defect rather than an incidental setup error.
The causal chain names trigger, broken invariant, divergence boundary, and visible symptom.
Alternative hypotheses are falsified through one-variable observations rather than broad speculative edits.
The minimal fix turns the focused loop green, relevant regressions pass, and temporary instrumentation is removed.
